hooks.text: 在每日时限内用工具和诊断设备修复程序生成的飞船模块
hooks.excerpt: Fix Stuff Using a range of tools, diagnostic devices, parts and workshop appliances, you’ll be correcting faults in the modules of procedurally generated spaceships. From simple refuel jobs to total overhauls, get ready to frantically fumble, slice, loosen, tighten, grab and drop as you try to complete as many jobs as you can within each daily time limit.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 查阅维修手册与图解，按步骤诊断模块并操作工坊设备
hooks.excerpt: Read Stuff Flaunt your basic literacy by consulting manual pages for guidance on diagnosing and correcting faults in spaceship modules, as well as operating workshop appliances. And if basic literacy isn’t your bag, then at least you’ve got pretty diagrams to gawp at!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 递增租金推动重复经营，部分空间站升级可跨局保留
hooks.excerpt: Do All That Stuff Again, but Better Meeting those escalating R.E.N.T payments ain’t gonna be easy, but chin up, champ – certain station upgrades will persist across gameplay runs, making life a little more tolerable every time around.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
